root: ^Oh, a pirate's life is the life for me!
^Hello, sir... I don't think it is safe.
^A young lady? What are you doing here, the show did not started yet!
^Tweedle Dee was looking for his brother and I am pretty sure that's him... He's worried sick, sir!
^And how can you be so sure it is him?
^He said they look the same, but different...
^She's right, Dodo! I am Tweedle Dum and I am not a part of your knife throwing act!
^But without my memory cards, knife throwing is the only way for me to dazzle the audience with my eye of an eagle!
^And what could make it more engaging than throwing knives at a living target?
^If you keep throwing these knives at me, I won't be a 'living' target for long!!!
^Sir, if I help you find your cards, will you let Tweedle Dum go?
^You'd do that? That's so kind of you, young lady!
^But... I haven't seen my cards for quite a while! What if my memory got terrible and I'll fumble the whole show with this trick?!
^Come to think of it, I think it's safer to stick with my knife throwing act.
^Okay, okay! Then how about I help you practise after I find your cards, would that be alright?
^Besides, then you can throw knives at the cards, I'm sure that you hitting such small targets will be impressive for your audience as well.
^And you won't kill your targets by accident!
^It seems you really want me to let that whining mermaid go, young lady...
^Well, if you give me all the help you promised, then so be it! I will alter the schedule of my performance for you.
